text:
Type: rectangular coffee table with open shelves
Use: holding books, magazines and drinks; living room
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: brown wood-veneer finish, tempered glass top, solid wood tapered legs
Colors: dark walnut brown, clear glass
Shape: low long box with two open compartments under a glass top, raised on four splayed tapered legs with a stretcher frame, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, refined, vintage, orderly
Goes with: walnut or teak, mustard or olive textiles, brass accents; mid-century or retro living rooms

product.name: REGISSR
product.description: The embossed grain surface in the poplar veneer enhances the wood feeling and gives each piece of furniture its own unique character.
